latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of accelerator-application-coach:

- Provides comprehensive coaching for founders considering and applying to top global startup accelerators.
- Offers a detailed diagnostic checklist to ensure tailored, relevant guidance before giving application tips.
- Covers every phase: deciding whether to apply, writing the application, interview prep, and evaluating offers or handling rejections.
- Explains differences among major accelerators, equity terms, and cultural/structural fit.
- Clearly distinguishes accelerator coaching from pitch deck and general fundraising advice.
